mBuff.mDescription: <titleLeft>Pirate Hunter</titleLeft><mainText>Yarr! I'm a mighty Pirate... hunter!</mainText><postScriptLeft>Source: @SourceName@</postScriptLeft>
<titleLeft>Bullet Time </titleLeft><mainText>Miss Fortune is unloading a flurry of bullets!</mainText><postScriptLeft>Source: @SourceName@</postScriptLeft>

mLocKeys.keySummary: Miss Fortune channels a barrage of bullets into a cone in front of her, dealing large amounts of damage to enemies. Each wave of Bullet Time can critically strike
mLocKeys.keyTooltip:
Miss Fortune channels a barrage of bullets, firing @BaseWaves@ waves over @BaseChannelDuration@ seconds, dealing @PhysicalDamagePerWave@ physical damage per wave (total @TotalPhysicalDamage@ physical damage).

Each wave can critically strike for %i:scaleCrit% @CritDamagePerWave@ physical damage.
mLocKeys.keyTooltipSimple: <font color='#FF9900'>Channel:</font> Miss Fortune unleash a barrage of bullets, dealing massive damage.

mLocKeys.keySummary: Miss Fortune deals bonus physical damage whenever she basic attacks a new target.
mLocKeys.keyTooltip:
Miss Fortune's Attacks deal an additional @TotalDamage@ physical damage when she attacks a new target.

Triggering {{ Spell_MissFortunePassive_Name }} reduces the cooldown of {{ Spell_MissfortuneW_Name }} by @Spell.MissFortuneViciousStrikes:LoveTapRefund@ seconds.

mLocKeys.keySummary: Miss Fortune fires a bullet at an enemy, damaging them and a target behind them. Both strikes can also apply Love Tap.
mLocKeys.keyTooltip:
Miss Fortune fires a bouncing shot, dealing @TotalDamageTooltip@ physical damage to an enemy and to another one behind them.

The second shot can critically strike for @TotalDamageCrit@ physical damage. It always critically strikes if the first shot kills its target.
mLocKeys.keyTooltipSimple:
Fires a bouncing shot, damaging the target and another enemy behind.

If this kills the first target, deals extra damage to the second.

mLocKeys.keySummary: Miss Fortune reveals an area with a flurry of bullets, dealing waves of damage to opponents and slowing them.
mLocKeys.keyTooltip: Miss Fortune rains bullets, revealing an area, <status>Slowing</status> by @TotalSlowAmount@ and dealing <magicDamage>@TotalDamagePerSecond@ magic damage</magicDamage> per second for @BaseDuration@ seconds (total <magicDamage>@TotalDamage@ magic damage</magicDamage>).
mLocKeys.keyTooltipSimple: Miss Fortune showers the area with bullets, damaging and slowing enemies.

mBuff.mDescription: <titleLeft>Strut</titleLeft><mainText>Miss Fortune has increased Move Speed until she is hit in combat.</mainText><postScriptLeft>Source: @SourceName@</postScriptLeft>
<titleLeft>Strut</titleLeft><mainText>Miss Fortune has increased Move Speed until she is hit in combat.</mainText><postScriptLeft>Source: @SourceName@</postScriptLeft>
<titleLeft>Guns Blazing </titleLeft><mainText>Miss Fortune has increased Attack Speed.</mainText><postScriptLeft>Source: @SourceName@</postScriptLeft>

mLocKeys.keySummary: Miss Fortune passively gains Move Speed when not attacked. This ability can be activated to grant bonus Attack Speed for a short duration. While it's on cooldown, Love Taps reduce the remaining cooldown of Strut.
mLocKeys.keyTooltip:
Passive: After @PassiveBaseMSOOC@ seconds of not taking damage, Miss Fortune gains @PassiveBaseMS@ Move Speed. After another @PassiveMaxMSExtraOOC@ seconds, this increases to @PassiveMaxMS@.

Active: Gain the passive effect's full Move Speed bonus and @ActiveAS*100@% Attack Speed for @ActiveDuration@ seconds.

Love Taps reduce the Cooldown of this Ability by @LoveTapRefund@ seconds.
mLocKeys.keyTooltipSimple:
Passive: Gain up to @PassiveMaxMS@ Move Speed if you haven't taken damage recently.

Active: Gain @ActiveAS*100@% Attack Speed for @ActiveDuration@ seconds.

mBuff.mDescription: <titleLeft>Strut Cooldown</titleLeft><mainText>Miss Fortune has taken damage and Strut is on cooldown.</mainText><postScriptLeft>Source: @SourceName@</postScriptLeft>
